The '''Belgaroth system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the home system to seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Belgaroth]]. The [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] was located nearby.
